basic_info.description: Temporary Waivers in place AMI +20%; Remove First Time Buyer Requirement; Household Size; Lower Financing and more!  See docs.     2 bedroom Below Market Rate (BMR) SOMA housing opportunity available at 100% Area Median Income  (AMI). Maximum income for 2 people = $119,900; 3 = $134,850, 4 = 149,850 etc. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. The unit will be available on a first come first served basis starting on 06/21/2024 at 8:00 AM PST. Please visit https://www.sf.gov/step-by-step/1400-mission-street-unit-314 to view the listing and for application & program info. Equal Housing Opportunity.   Parking:  No parking space.  Leased parking may be available in building or nearby parking garage.
